what: Three doc-vs-code mismatches found in MANUAL_E2E_VALIDATION.md during 2026-04-22 full-scenario simulation against /tmp/aide-e2e (all hook-dispatcher paths simulated via direct `node dist/cli/aide-memory.js hook <name>` stdin pipes): (1) STEP 3 SessionStart injection: doc says scoped guidelines like "API uses camelCase" at `src/api/**` should NOT surface at SessionStart, but implementation calls `store.list({layer})` with no scope filter — old pre-0.4.0 `scripts/hooks/session-inject.js` had identical no-scope-filter impl (git show 09a898a confirms), so this isn't a 0.4.0 regression. Spec §657-661 only says "Scope-specific *preferences* still surfaced via Read/Edit hooks" — ambiguous for guidelines. Decision needed: fix doc to match code OR filter injection by scope. (2) STEP 6 gap-filling: doc says re-read with partially-covered IDs should be SOFT additionalContext, but implementation emits `decision:block`. Functionally agent still gets the right ids:[N] nudge. (3) STEP 8 correction phrasing: doc example `"no, we use epoch seconds not milliseconds"` does NOT match CORRECTION_PATTERN — the regex requires `no[, ]+(don't|use|instead|...)` so the word directly after `no, ` must be a correction verb, not `we`. Doc example should be `"no, use epoch seconds instead"`. Existing detect-correction.test.sh uses correct phrasing (`no, dont use tabs`). Remediation: fix the three doc snippets rather than the code, since the actual behavior is intentional per spec + history.
why: These mismatches would cause future validators to report false regressions. Captured so the doc can be updated in a focused commit rather than wasted debugging loops next time someone runs the manual walk.
